first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making simplification the most directly aligned intervention and one with prior evidence of durable self-serve adoption gains. A small guarded test limits the risk that easier completion increases low-quality accounts or fails to improve qualified revenue. Verification of the onboarding and signup records will confirm applicability before rollout.

final.rationale: Run a small guarded onboarding simplification test focused on self-serve SMB accounts, where the verified evidence is most applicable. Shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines. The signup record also shows a modest qualified-revenue gain but a 1% retention decrease and no evidence beyond SMB, so monitor qualified revenue and retention—not completion alone—and avoid broad rollout until those outcomes are confirmed.
